_doc: Render massing for the Verrijzeniskerk (Burgemeester Pyckestraat, Doorniksewijk; OSM way 581276680, Q104684849), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. GRB 1739037 (round, 3D GRB 8.1 m) rendered as a flat grey disc. Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor' (vertex mean), axis_deg -53.8 (irrelevant for a round plan). DHMV II: a cone from ~3 m at the rim to ~8 m half way and 12-14 m at the centre (u 1.5, v -1.5), ~22 m across. Look (Onroerend Erfgoed photo 10793 in refs/, orthophoto; no Street View, the browser was not connected): modern round church with low white walls, a pleated green copper roof of star points, and a green copper lantern with a thin spire and cross in the middle.

parts.id: pleated green copper roof (as a cone)
